label: US travellers who intend to use AI for future trips
question: Will travellers keep using AI to plan trips?
answer: 75% of US travellers say they intend to use AI for future trips, against 54% who have already done so.
methodology: Same instrument as the adoption figure: 1,006 US adults, April 2026. Stated intent is a weaker signal than reported behaviour and systematically overstates future action, which is why we show it next to the behavioural number rather than instead of it.
